intro: Written to common/dynamic_modifiers/ — the same kind of modifier an idea carries, but attachable and removable at runtime (enable / remove_trigger).
emptyScoped: No dynamic modifiers under {country} · click 「+ New」
selectHint: Select a dynamic modifier on the left to edit · or click 「+ New」
collisionWarning: ⚠ {id} has the same name as a vanilla dynamic_modifier · loading the mod will silently override vanilla
enableLabel: enable · trigger block (optional · modifier won't apply when the trigger isn't met)
removeTriggerLabel: remove_trigger · trigger block (optional · auto-removes the modifier when met)
noFields: No fields · click 「+ Add field」 to add a vanilla modifier field
